title: Design System: Lakshya Jain — Personal Site

body.purpose: All prose, list entries, meta labels.

heading.purpose: The name at the top of the page only.

components.name: Link
components.description: The page's only interactive element -- inline text, underlined at rest, darkening on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #171717; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #e5e5e5; text-underline-offset: 2px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { text-decoration-color: #171717; }

components.name: List Entry
components.description: A Work or Writing row: plain prose, no card, no border.

components.name: Facts List
components.description: The two-column bio facts (Status, Focus, Based in, ...).
components.css: .ds-fact { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-fact-label { width: 80px; flex-shrink: 0; color: #666666; } .ds-fact-value { color: #171717; }

narrative.overview: The site is one page of plain text: a name, a short bio, and four lists (work, writing, photos, contact), read top to bottom with no navigation beyond in-page jumps. It follows the genre of radically minimal personal-site design without imitating any one person's actual page or copy. This is a deliberate, user-requested reversal of every decorated world this project carried earlier: no card, no button, no shadow, no sourced display face, no accent color.
keyCharacteristics: One page, no navigation chrome: every former subpage is a same-page anchor now, reached by redirect for old links.
No sourced font: Georgia (a system serif) carries every weight of type.
No accent color: ink and a single hairline gray are the entire palette.
Content over container: work and writing are inline text lines, never cards.
Honest placeholders persist unchanged: bracketed, italic, muted text still marks unfilled facts.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: Nothing on this page uses a saturated color. A future addition that reaches for one has left this world.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: Every weight of type on the page is Georgia. No mono, no script, no second family.

rules.name: The Flat-Always Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow appears anywhere in this system. Depth is not part of this world's vocabulary.

dos: Do keep the whole page to one system serif and two text colors plus one hairline gray.
Do keep every actionable element a plain underlined text link -- no button anywhere.
Do keep honest, bracketed, italic placeholder styling for any fact that isn't real yet.
Do redirect old subpage routes to /#anchor rather than reintroducing separate page chrome.
donts: Don't add a card, shadow, border-radius, or button.
Don't source a display font or add a second type family.
Don't fabricate a live stat, visitor count, or activity feed.
